title: Humans Made Something Five Trillion Degrees Hot

scenes.text: Humans once made something five trillion degrees hot.
In 2012, scientists at CERN smashed lead ions together at almost the speed of light.
The collisions made quark gluon plasma, a soup of particles from just after the Big Bang.
It reached over five trillion degrees, the hottest temperature ever made on Earth.
The surface of the Sun is only about five and a half thousand.
The hottest thing ever made was smaller than an atom.

description:
CERN's Large Hadron Collider created the hottest temperature ever made by humans, over five trillion degrees.
It did it by smashing lead ions together, briefly recreating the state of the universe just after the Big Bang.
What would you want to learn from a collision like that? Comment below.
first_comment: CERN made something over five trillion degrees. What is the hottest thing you have ever touched?
